resolved_findings.finding: Setup Data(contentsOf:) could block launch on nonregular files and exceed size precheck
resolved_findings.resolution: SetupStore now calls shared BoundedFile.read with nonblocking/no-follow open, fstat regular validation, and 1 MiB read cap; FIFO and oversized regression tests present

observations: Configuration applies only after successful save, or explicit session-only acceptance
Dismissed setup draft does not mutate active configuration
Saved version and types rejected before overwrite; filters and results remain session-only
Reference wording distinguishes candidates, unsupported coverage, and modification-date proxy
Derived AppMark visibly matches rendered source RGB; IconMaster composes this art on rounded white tile while preserving source

visual_review.observations: Light and dark setup actions and text are readable; populated catalog retains clear collection/navigation/inspector hierarchy. Corrected supplied black block-and-stem artwork is visible in setup, sidebar, and actual Dock beside Terminal. No blocking clipping or overlap observed.

limitations: Source and provided runtime-artifact review; reviewer did not independently run test suite or interact with app
Current Mac only; Intel and older macOS not exercised
VoiceOver human validation and native open-panel interaction not performed
First visual baseline; no previous image diff
No .qa-criteria access or product code changes
